title: 第17章 炼器连续突破第18章 发现金元丹
content_zh:
顾景元这边，离开百宝阁之后，连忙朝着人多的地方走去。
紧接着找到一处角落，立刻将身上的衣服换了一套，面具也收入储物袋中，紧接着又混入人群离去。
“还好每次出售和外出猎杀妖兽我都有带着面具的习惯。”
顾景元不由的庆幸。
而身后，原本跟着顾景元的小厮只见对方混入人流，便再也不见踪迹。
百宝阁内，贺初云皱眉看着张庆民，问道：“跟丢了？”
张庆民无奈点头：“嗯，那人混入众人之中，就不见踪迹了。不过他购买了一阶中品法器青蟒旗，可以根据这个去查。”
贺初云继续道：“查出此人来历，我才会让父亲去举荐的。”
张庆民：“我明白。”
......
另一边，顾景元在坊市兜兜转转，见身后确实没有人跟踪之后，这才返回院落中。
院落中，此刻热闹已经落幕，他也直接返回房间，开始修炼起来。
身上还有两瓶炼灵丹，加上刚刚的事情，他打算短时间不出去了，在院中炼化丹药先。
时间如白驹过隙，转眼间又是一个多月过去，顾景元在这边也已经三个月了。
期间炼化不少炼灵丹，如今身上只剩下一瓶了，同时青蟒旗也被炼化。
“之前是想在这边猎杀妖兽，但如今得罪了百宝阁的人，也不好外出猎杀了。正好有了新的炼器鼎，储物袋中也有不少材料，再购买一些辅助材料，便可六七份下品法器和三四份中品法器的材料。”
顾景元盘算着，片刻后离开院落前往一处名为宝器阁的地方购买材料。
耗费一百五十多灵石。
返回房间之后便可开始尝试炼制。
赤云鼎祭出，开始温鼎。

房间中赤焰缭绕，偶尔传出轻微的爆炸声和烧焦的气味，但顾景元一直没出来。
就这样过了一个月，顾景元在小院的租赁到期了。
而此刻房间中，顾景元一脸满意的看着前方的四件法器。
“一阶下品的岩铁剑两柄，黑竹盾一件，中品法器：赤尾剑一柄，应该能卖出三百出头的灵石。”
顾景元收拾一下，石锋不在，他和石依珊告别之后，便离开了。
先是找到一处收法器的地方，将四件法器全部出售。
岩铁剑四十灵石一柄，黑竹盾五十五灵石，赤尾剑一百九十灵石，一起是三百二十五块灵石，加上储物袋中的三百灵石，共六百二十五块。
接下来顾景元直接前往购买了一个下品灵兽袋，五十灵石，紧接着又前往出售丹药的地方，大肆采购。
炼灵丹六瓶，四百二十灵石；灵蜜丹四瓶，二十灵石，灵浆丹两瓶，四十灵石，玉蜂丹一瓶，三十灵石，共计五百一十块灵石。
顾景元没有讨价还价，但让对方送了五瓶灵兽丸。
“炼灵丹六瓶，加上储物袋中的一瓶，一共七瓶，配合灵泉眼和凝金晶元丹应该能修炼到炼气五层后期去。五瓶灵兽丸喂给其他的红玉蜂，灵蜜丹，灵浆丹，以及更高级的玉蜂丹，全部留给赤玉......”
将东西全部收好，在坊市中转了转，确认没有人跟着这才离开坊市。
三天后，返回沧澜峰洞府之中。
四个月时间过去，洞府依旧没有什么变化，只是金斑叶成熟了。
content_en:
On Gu Jingyuan's side, after leaving Baibao Pavilion, he quickly walked towards a crowded place.
Then he found a corner, immediately changed his clothes, put the mask into his storage bag, and then blended into the crowd and left.
"Fortunately, I have the habit of wearing a mask every time I sell or go out to hunt monsters."
Gu Jingyuan couldn't help but feel happy.
Behind him, the boy who was originally following Gu Jingyuan saw him disappear into the crowd and disappeared.
In the Baibao Pavilion, He Chuyun frowned at Zhang Qingmin and asked, "Have you lost me?"
Zhang Qingmin nodded helplessly: "Well, that person blended into the crowd and disappeared. However, he purchased a first-level medium-grade magical weapon, the Green Python Flag, and we can check based on this."
He Chuyun continued: "Only after I find out this person's origins will I ask my father to recommend him."
Zhang Qingmin: "I understand."
...
On the other side, Gu Jingyuan walked around the market and saw that no one was following him before he returned to the courtyard.
In the courtyard, the excitement had ended at this moment, and he returned directly to his room and began to practice.
He still had two bottles of elixirs on him. In addition to what happened just now, he planned not to go out for a while and refine the elixirs in the courtyard first.
Time flies by like a flash, and more than a month has passed in the blink of an eye. Gu Jingyuan has been here for three months.
During this period, a lot of spiritual elixirs were refined, and now I only have one bottle left with me. At the same time, the Green Python Flag was also refined.
"I wanted to hunt monsters here before, but now that I have offended the people in Baibao Pavilion, it is not easy to go out and hunt. We just have a new weapon refining cauldron, and there are a lot of materials in the storage bag. If we buy some auxiliary materials, we can have six or seven low-grade magic weapons and three or four middle-grade magic weapons."
Gu Jingyuan thought about it, and after a while he left the courtyard and went to a place called Baoqi Pavilion to buy materials.
It cost more than one hundred and fifty spiritual stones.
After returning to the room, you can start trying to refine it.
The Red Cloud Cauldron was sacrificed and the cauldron began to be warmed.
The room was filled with red flames, and occasionally there was a slight explosion sound and a burning smell, but Gu Jingyuan never came out.
A month passed like this, and Gu Jingyuan's lease in the courtyard expired.
At this moment in the room, Gu Jingyuan looked at the four magical artifacts in front of him with a satisfied expression.
"Two first-grade low-grade rock iron swords, a black bamboo shield, and a medium-grade magic weapon: a red tail sword. It should be able to sell for over three hundred spiritual stones."
Gu Jingyuan tidied up. Shi Feng was not there. He said goodbye to Shi Yishan and left.
First, find a place to collect magic weapons and sell all four magic weapons.
The Rock Iron Sword has 40 spirit stones, the Black Bamboo Shield has 55 spirit stones, and the Red Tail Sword has 190 spirit stones. Together they are 325 spirit stones, plus the 300 spirit stones in the storage bag, a total of 625.
Next, Gu Jingyuan went directly to buy a low-grade spirit beast bag and fifty spirit stones, and then went to the place where pills were sold and made a large purchase.
Six bottles of Spiritual Refining Pill, 420 Spiritual Stones; four bottles of Spiritual Honey Pill, 20 Spiritual Stones, two bottles of Spiritual Serum Pill, 40 Spiritual Stones, one bottle of Jade Bee Pill, 30 Spiritual Stones, a total of 510 Spiritual Stones.
Gu Jingyuan did not bargain, but asked the other party to give him five bottles of spirit beast pills.
"Six bottles of Spirit Refining Pill, plus one bottle in the storage bag, a total of seven bottles. With the Spiritual Spring Eye and the Gold Condensing Crystal Yuan Pill, you should be able to practice to the late stage of the fifth level of Qi Refining. The five bottles of Spirit Beast Pills are fed to other Red Jade Bees, Spirit Honey Pills, Spirit Pulp Pills, and the higher-level Jade Bee Pills, all of which are reserved for Red Jade..."
After putting all the things away, he walked around Fangshi and made sure no one was following him before leaving Fangshi.
Three days later, return to Canglan Peak Cave Mansion.
Four months have passed, and there is still no change in the cave, except that the golden spotted leaves have matured.
